patch_description:
This version uses a staged deterministic portfolio rather than spending the full budget on every initial configuration. It combines staggered-ring, cube-axis, icosahedral, and random seeds, lightly perturbs them reproducibly, performs a cheaper smooth-contact screening phase, and then allocates longer continuation refinement only to the strongest exact-ratio survivors.

The optimizer uses a log-distance soft-min/soft-max objective, which is more scale-stable near active contacts. Exact squared min/max ratio checkpoints remain authoritative throughout. A final monotone sharp-contact polishing stage evaluates multiple step sizes and occasional transverse perturbations, accepting only exact objective improvements.
